name: Chain Devil

actions.name: Animate Chains
actions.effect: Up to 2 chains within 18m animate and attack different targets. Each target must pass PHYS save or be grappled and restrained by the chain.

actions.name: Unnerving Mask
actions.effect: The Chain Devil's face shifts to resemble a loved one of the target. Target must pass WILL save or be frightened and stunned for 1 round.

reactions.name: Chain Shield
reactions.effect: Wraps chains around itself defensively. +4 to all defenses against one attack.

reactions.name: Chain Snare
reactions.effect: When a creature within 6m tries to move away, a chain lashes out. Target must pass PHYS save or be unable to move.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Can see perfectly in magical and non-magical darkness up to 36m.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: +1d6 to saves against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Chain Master
traits.desc: Any chains within 18m of the Chain Devil are treated as its weapons. It can control up to 4 chains simultaneously.

lore: Chain Devils are the torturers and jailers of the Nine Hells. They are draped in animate chains that they control telekinetically, and their faces shift to show the visages of those their victims love, weaponizing grief and terror.
